_doc: Real YouTube fixtures. request is what the user types after the URL (default: lang); followup is a second turn in the same conversation. sets: fetch = network tier (tests/test_real_videos.py, no LLM); slim = default agent eval; full = slim plus the expensive cases. expect.lang is the transcript language the fetcher must pick and the report must be written in. known_bug marks a fetch expectation that fails today (strict xfail, so a fix flips it to a failure to un-mark).

fixtures.name: smoke
fixtures.why: 3 min, English auto-captions, 5 chapters: the happy path, chapter-anchored outline.

fixtures.name: german
fixtures.why: 9 min, German only, no chapters: language fidelity and a free-form outline.

fixtures.name: lang-request
fixtures.why: German video whose default track is a manual English one; the requested de track must win. 8 German chapters. The control for focus: same transcript, no focus.

fixtures.name: focus
fixtures.request: in German, focus on the battery and range
fixtures.why: A language plus a focus (EXTRA_REQUEST): battery and range get more room than in lang-request, and the other chapters stay covered. expect.focus is a regex over the focus's words in the report language.

fixtures.name: revision
fixtures.followup: Tighten the takeaway to one short sentence.
fixtures.why: A second turn in the same conversation: the revision re-renders with --replace, so one file, the same generation date, a new takeaway, and no edit of the HTML.

fixtures.name: lang-warn
fixtures.why: Requested language does not exist: LANG_WARN, English report, warning suffix on the meta line.

fixtures.name: no-captions
fixtures.why: Captions disabled: the agent must stop and offer local transcription, never run it unasked.

fixtures.name: long
fixtures.why: 1h36m talk, 11 chapters: the full-transcript reading path (>90 min band).

fixtures.name: auto-dub
fixtures.why: German video with an auto-dubbed en-US track listed first; with no request the fetcher must pick the original de track.

fixtures.name: region-subtag
fixtures.why: Only a de-DE track exists; a de request must match it by primary subtag.
